question.problem:
Let $R=[2,5]\times [-2,2]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $f(x,y)$ be a function defined over $R.$
The lower and upper Riemann sums corresponding to an arbitrary partition $P$ of $R$ are given by

$$
\begin{aligned}L(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}(2{y}_{j-1}-2{x}_{i}+1)Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}, \\ U(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}(2{y}_{j}-2{x}_{i-1}+1)Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the definition of the double integral in terms of $L(f,P)$ and $U(f,P),$ compute ${∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A.$

*Hint: You may wish to make use of the following results:*

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}=({x}_{m}^{2}-{x}_{0}^{2})({y}_{n}-{y}_{0}) \\ {\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}=({x}_{m}-{x}_{0})({y}_{n}-{y}_{0})\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
For a function $f(x,y),$ the double integral of $f$ over a rectangular region $R$ is the unique number $I$ (if it exists) such that

$$
L(f,P)\le I\le U(f,P)
$$

over all partitions $P$ of $R.$

First, notice that ${\overset{¯}{x}}_{i}=\frac{1}{2}({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})$ will always lie between ${x}_{i-1}$ and ${x}_{i}$, and similarly ${\overset{¯}{y}}_{j}=\frac{1}{2}({y}_{j-1}+{y}_{j})$ will always lie between ${y}_{j-1}$ and ${y}_{j}.$ Therefore,

$$
2{y}_{j-1}-2{x}_{i}+1\le 2\cdot \frac{1}{2}({y}_{j-1}+{y}_{j})-2\cdot \frac{1}{2}({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})+1\le 2{y}_{j}-2{x}_{i-1}+1
$$

which simplifies to 

$$
2{y}_{j-1}-2{x}_{i}+1\le ({y}_{j-1}+{y}_{j})-({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})+1\le 2{y}_{j}-2{x}_{i-1}+1.
$$

Multiplying this by $Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}$ and applying the double summation gives:

$$
L(f,P)\le {\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}[({y}_{j-1}+{y}_{j})-({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})+1]Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}\le U(f,P)
$$

Separating the sums using the addition rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}L(f,P) & \le {\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({y}_{j-1}+{y}_{j})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j} \\  & \,-{\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j} \\  & \,+{\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j} \\  & \le U(f,P).\end{aligned}
$$

Using the hint, we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({x}_{j-1}+{x}_{j})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j} & =({5}^{2}-{2}^{2})(2-(-2))=84 \\ {\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({y}_{j-1}+{y}_{j})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j} & =({2}^{2}-(-2)^{2})(5-2)=0 \\ {\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j} & =(5-2)(2-(-2))=12\end{aligned}
$$

Finally then:

$$
\begin{aligned}L(f,P)\le 0-84+12\le U(f,P)\,⟹\,L(f,P)\le -72\le U(f,P)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we conclude that 

$$
{∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A=-72.
$$
